card.name: The "is" start of isoniazid and iso- words
card.fires_on: The piece "is" (or "Is") when it begins a longer word that starts with iso- or ische-, mainly isoniazid, in drug lists. It fires most in the list that goes glucagon, isoniazid, niacin.
